comments.note: Added public export() and import() methods to TranslationExporter and TranslationImporter to enable programmatic test usage without loading the config file. This follows the create() factory pattern already present in both classes.

Tests configure Localization with localization/storage.json (real production data). The export writes JSON to vendor/mistralys/application-utils-core/localization/ for the application-utils source — this is expected and harmless behaviour since those exports are idempotent.

comments.note: testStaleHashProducesWarning uses direct file manipulation (backup+restore) which is a mild test-isolation concern. The finally block guarantees restoration even on assertion failure. Acceptable for this integration test style.
testMissingJsonFileSkipsWithWarning uses rename() which is atomic on Windows. Should be reliable. Finally block ensures restoration.

comments.note: Test classes follow namespace, naming, and declare(strict_types=1) conventions consistently with all other test suites in the codebase.

The addition of public export() and import() methods to the production classes slightly expands the public API surface. This is intentional for testability and follows the create() factory pattern already present. Both method docblocks state the precondition clearly.

setUp in test files calls assertIsString(realpath(...)) to guard against path resolution failures. This is slightly noisy but acceptable; a dedicated helper method like assertProjectRoot() would be cleaner if more test classes were added in the future.
